title: wolfSSL PKCS7 ORI OID processing stack buffer overflow
bug_class: PKCS7 ORI OID processing stack buffer overflow
input_type: crafted CMS EnvelopedData / PKCS7 envelope with oversized ORI OID
notes: Candidate selected from wolfSSL official security vulnerability entry, NVD, and GitHub Advisory. Expected root cause: wc_PKCS7_DecryptOri copies an ASN.1 parsed ORI OID into oriOID[MAX_OID_SZ] without validating OID length first. Requires PKCS7 support and ORI decrypt callback.
crash_signal: AddressSanitizer stack-buffer-overflow; WRITE of size 80; wc_PKCS7_DecryptOri -> wc_PKCS7_DecodeEnvelopedData; oriOID[MAX_OID_SZ] overflow
fixed_behavior: wc_PKCS7_DecodeEnvelopedData returned -140 with no ASan crash
reproduction_summary: A reconstructed PKCS7/CMS EnvelopedData input contains an OtherRecipientInfo with an 80-byte ORI OID. In v5.9.0-stable, wc_PKCS7_DecryptOri copies the 80-byte OID into oriOID[MAX_OID_SZ], producing an ASan stack-buffer-overflow. In v5.9.1-stable and current, the oversized OID is rejected before the copy.
